header.description: Language labels for the AI assistant answers backend module

trans-unit.source: The answers the assistant gives for questions it recognises. Write your own, take one over from a logged answer, and review the corrections visitors made. An active answer is played back whenever a question matches it in meaning.

Every answer here replaces what the assistant would have said on its own. Matching is by meaning, so a visitor does not have to use the wording you wrote. New entries can be written here or taken over from a logged answer in the "Enquiries" module; corrections visitors made in the chat arrive below for review.
Answers are only used on sites where "Learn from visitor corrections" is switched on in the site configuration.
The answers table does not exist yet. Please run the database schema update (Admin Tools › Maintenance › Analyze Database Structure).
This module requires an active subscription.
No visitor corrections are waiting for review.
These answers are in use. The assistant plays one back verbatim as soon as a visitor's question matches it closely enough.
The question is what the entry is matched against, the answer is what the assistant says. Matching is by meaning, so a visitor does not have to use the exact wording.
Please enter an answer — it is what the assistant will say.
The correction has been approved and is now in use.
The question this entry answers. Visitors may phrase it differently — matching is done by meaning.
Played back to the visitor exactly as written, so phrase it as a complete, self-contained reply.
Optional. Leave empty to derive them from the question and answer. Additional keywords widen the range of questions that match.
Site identifier the entry applies to. Must match the site, otherwise the answer is never used.
Language of the site the entry applies to (0 = default language).
Only active answers are used by the assistant.
